quests.title: The Clock at Kirrawee
quests.blurb: Somebody set the Kirrawee clock that way on purpose and everyone who knows why is nearly gone. The old crew drink near Gymea on a wet Monday. Go and ask, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Gymea, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Villawood
quests.blurb: A dog meets the 5:40 at Villawood every weekday and nobody gets off for it. Four months of this. I have decided it is not going to be a sad story. Find out whose it is.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Clyde
quests.blurb: I run a small book on things that are not races — weather, delays, whether the the back of seven out of Clyde runs on time. Somebody is beating it by information, not luck. Ride the run they ride.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$39 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Kingswood
quests.blurb: Nothing runs out of Kingswood after half six. I lock this end and a bloke everyone calls Macca locks the other and in between there is a kilometre of lit platform for nobody. Ride the last one to Penrith and bring me a photograph of that.

steps.label: ride the late one to Penrith
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Mulgrave Tap-Off
quests.blurb: A card ending 45 boards at Mulgrave on grand final week and vanishes. Not a fare thing — ninety cents. I want to know *how*, and I am past being reasonable about it.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The St James Order
quests.blurb: I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at St James. Since a Tuesday they have not turned up, and I am the only one who seems to have noticed. Go and knock.

steps.label: order one at the St James kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $40 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Marion
quests.blurb: Nobody upstairs believes me about Marion because I have 7 years and no data. Go and stand on that platform on the first of the month and get me the data, and they keep sending a different bloke.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Chinatown
quests.blurb: Everything anyone leaves on the Chinatown line ends up in a room and the room is full. Nine hundred umbrellas and one a milk crate with a name on it and a number that rings out. Go to the address on the tag.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$37 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Padstow
quests.blurb: The quiet carriage runs on shame and somebody on the just gone midnight out of Padstow has stopped feeling it. Ride it, see the crime, and apply the shame manually.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Bondi Junction Shortcut
quests.blurb: Nine minutes between the shortcut at Bondi Junction and the long way, and nine minutes is four drops. Since the first of the month there has been a padlock on it, and nobody will put it in writing.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$41, which is what the long way costs me a week
